prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pasadena, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1355; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state the location where the accident occurred.

A: It was at an intersection in Pasadena, Texas. I was turning left from the main road onto a side street.

Q: Can you describe the traffic conditions at the time?

A: It was fairly busy. The light had just turned green for me, and there was a vehicle coming toward me from the other direction.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: I saw it, but I thought it had more room than it did. I started my turn and then it was right on me.

Q: Where were you hit, and how fast would you estimate you were moving?

A: The front of my car was hit on the driver's side. I was going slowly, maybe ten or fifteen miles an hour, since I was turning.

Q: Did you receive any medical attention after the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. My neck was really stiff and sore, and the doctor said it looked like whiplash.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. I have neck pain and headaches, and it's hard to turn my head to check my blind spot when I drive. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?

A: A few days, yes. My job involves a lot of sitting and I could not focus well on the first few days.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think I've covered it. I just want to get my car repaired and get my neck back to normal.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
